$comment: One entry per method: its body, or one body per request op (`selected_by`). `encoding` is the ResultPayload variant; a `Raw` body is a MessagePack `bin` holding the MessagePack encoding of `schema`, a `Json` body is that value as a JSON tree. A body with a `dynamic` reason is chosen by the caller and has the unconstrained schema `true`.

ClusterDiscoverySnapshot.description: `ClusterMembers`: a signed, context-bound cluster topology snapshot.

ClusterGroup.description: One Raft group and its members.

ClusterLeader.description: The current leader of one Raft group.

ClusterMember.description: One member of a Raft group.

health.description: `healthy` when the group has an elected leader, else `degraded`.

ClusterMemberCertificate.description: Certificate metadata a member self-reported. Never key material.

Digest256.description: 32 bytes of SHA-256 as lowercase hexadecimal

DiscoveryAuthBinding.description: Digests of the verified request context a discovery snapshot is signed for.

DiscoveryCounts.description: How many of each MCP primitive the probe saw.

oneOf.description:
Recorded rather than omitted: "unavailable" must never look identical to
"empty". `error` is caller-redacted text; it is bounded here and never
interpreted.

DiscoveryScope.description:
Under whose authority a discovery observation was made.

Closed, and deliberately two-valued. A local/stdio probe has no provider
grant to fingerprint, so it is tenant-local and visible to the tenant; a
probe made with a principal's OAuth grant saw what THAT grant allows, so it
is visible only to that principal while that grant is current. There is no
third "global" value: an observation that cannot say which of the two it is
is not recorded.

oneOf.description:
`grant_digest` is the broker-minted fingerprint of the grant the probe
used. The principal is NOT a field: the server binds it from the
verified request context.

DistResult.description:
The result of a distributed computation, in a wire-ready form. Serialized to
`ResultPayload::Raw` by the handler.

oneOf.description: PageRank: `(id, score)` rows, sorted by id (deterministic).

Connected components: `(id, component_repr_index)` rows, sorted by id. The
component label is the index of the component's representative in the sorted
vertex list (a stable small int), so it round-trips losslessly.

FleetCatalogCursor.description: Where a page resumes, fenced to the snapshot that produced it.

after_name.description: Exclusive `(lowercased name, id)` lower bound for the next page.

snapshot_digest.description:
Digest of the whole visible, filtered snapshot of the page's kind. The
fence is content, not a graph revision: a registry heartbeat that changes
nothing this kind shows must not invalidate a caller's cursor.

FleetCatalogKind.description: Which kind of row a page lists.

FleetCatalogLookup.description:
The visible rows for a lookup, in request order. Unknown and invisible ids
are both simply absent.

FleetCatalogPage.description: One bounded page of one kind, fenced to the snapshot it was cut from.

total.description: Every visible row matching the request's filter, across all pages.

FleetComponentRef.description: The part of every content row that identifies its component revision.

enabled.description: Published, and its server is not registered as disabled.

name.description: The name the server itself uses.

FleetDiscoveryRow.description: One server's latest observation under one scope.

FleetRowAcl.description: Who may see a row, and who published what it shows.

publisher.description:
The opaque persistence id of the principal that wrote the underlying
record: the observer for a discovery row, the importer for a component.

classification.description: `skill_type`'s display label, computed by the engine.

override_revision.description: The override record's revision, when an override decided `skill_type`.

input_schema_digest.description: `sha256:<hex>` of the served input schema, when the pack pinned one.

FleetVisibility.description: Who may see a row, as the engine decided it.

oneOf.description: Every verified principal of the tenant.

Only `principal` (an opaque persistence id), while the grant that made
the observation is current.

FleetWriteDisposition.description: What a fleet catalog write did.

oneOf.description: The stored record already said exactly this; nothing was committed.

FleetWriteReceipt.description: What one fleet catalog write committed.

record_id.description: The logical record id (a discovery id, or `ovr:<field>:<component id>`).

revision.description: The record's revision after this write.

GraphListing.description: One graph the caller may read.

GroupReshardResult.description: One graph a placement move transferred between Raft groups.

HealthReport.description: `Health`: liveness plus the served-operation set clients negotiate against.

IndexCompleteness.description: Source rows a maintained index covers.

IndexManifestListing.description: One server-maintained index of a listed graph.

MaterializationCursor.description: Row offsets a partial materialization has reached.

MaterializationPhase.description: How much of a graph incarnation is materialized in memory.

PlacementMoveResult.description: `PlacementAdmin` op `move`: the settled online partition move.

PlacementRouteWire.description:
The `PlacementRoute` wire response: the schema-locked route fields plus
`endpoints`, the client-reachable members of the resolved group, leader first
(empty when no cluster topology is known).

Deliberately a separate type from [`crate::epistemic_operations::PlacementRoute`],
whose cross-repo DTO carries no deployment endpoint material and denies unknown
fields: a consumer of a route response must decode this tolerant superset.

RebalanceExecution.description: `RebalanceExecute`: every move the plan executed, in order.

RebalancePlanReport.description: `RebalancePlan`: the ordered moves plus the per-shard loads they were planned on.

RegisteredServerCursor.description: Stable continuation over one complete live registry snapshot.

after_name.description: Exclusive server-name lower bound for the next page.

registry_digest.description: Canonical digest of every live, visible typed server in that image.

registry_revision.description: `GraphCore::version()` of the `__commons__` image that produced the page.

RegisteredServerListPage.description: One revision- and digest-fenced live registry page.

observed_at_ms.description: Server-authoritative wall-clock observation used for lease filtering.

ResourceKind.description: What an MCP resource carries, from its URI scheme.

ServerDesiredState.description:
The operator's DESIRED state for a registered server.

Desired, not observed: whether the server answered its last probe is a
discovery observation (`FleetCatalog.RecordDiscovery`), and the two are
never collapsed into one status.

ServerTransport.description:
How a registered server is reached. Closed on purpose: a transport the
engine cannot name is `Unspecified`, never a free-form string.

oneOf.description: A registration that predates the typed field, or did not say.
A local child process speaking MCP over stdio.

ShardLoadSummary.description: The load of one shard the plan was computed against.

ShardReshardReport.description: One graph moved between durable shards.

no_op.description: The graph already lived on the target shard; nothing moved.

SkillType.description: How a skill is run. The four values the agent ecosystem declares.

SkillTypeSource.description: Which authority a skill row's type came from.

oneOf.description: A durable operator override. Wins over everything else.
The skill's own declaration, as its pack published it.
Nothing declared one; an ordinary atomic skill.

ToolEffect.description:
Whether invoking a tool can change anything.

Not a hint. A read-only agent graph is one whose reachable tools are all
[`ToolEffect::Read`], and that is a property worth being able to prove
before a run rather than discover during one.

ToolMode.description: Whether a tool takes the condensed `action` + `params_json` calling shape.

oneOf.description: The publisher did not declare one. Never guessed from the schema.

dynamic.summary: rows whose columns and value types are chosen by the caller's query text

title: cluster method results
